entities.name: Real-time Payment Fraud Screening Platform
entities.description: A real-time payment fraud screening platform that evaluates card-not-present transactions, provides case management for fraud analysts, blocks fraudulent transactions, and maintains immutable audit logs while complying with PCI-DSS Level 1.

entities.name: Fraud Analyst
entities.description: Evaluates flagged transactions and manages cases.

entities.name: Risk Operations Manager / Data Scientist
entities.description: Manages rules, models, and overall risk operations.

entities.name: Payment Processor / Merchant Systems
entities.description: External customer systems sending transaction data.

entities.name: Payment Gateway / Processor Core
entities.description: Core payment gateway routing authorization requests.

interfaces.description: Accesses case management for fraud review

naming_conventions: External systems are named using descriptive domain functions separated by slashes when representing alternatives or dual roles.
